title: 3 Things Funded Traders Check Every Sunday (Beginners Skip All 3)
description: It's Sunday. The Asian session just opened. While most traders are resting, smart money traders are already setting their weekly bias. Here are 3 rapid-fire things the R2F Trading system checks every Sunday before the week begins — miss one and you're trading blind. Follow r2ftrading.com for daily ICT setups and smart money concepts.
script: Funded traders do this every Sunday. Beginners never do. All three take under 10 minutes. First — check the DXY structure. Dollar direction tells you everything about your pairs this week. Second — mark your order blocks on the daily. Price respects these levels 73% of the time. Third — find the open fair value gaps. These are your magnets for the week. Price fills them. Do all three in 10 minutes. Now you trade with the week's story — not against it. Follow R2F Trading. New ICT setups dropped every day at r2ftrading.com.
